answer: Bees keep no minutes, but the beekeeper does, hive by hive. Proof of veterinary practice registration via veterinary council roll reads like those minutes: a roll entry the veterinary council has renewed annually. The falcon of the diary is the harvest - jars counted, weights written, numbers that add up. One forged season needs a jar and a label; a hundred need a hundred summers, and the nectar of each is the flowering date, fixed by weather the farm cannot reschedule. The zephyr that catches the lie is the honey: a yield claimed from a year when the orchards froze.
